subject: E2E MAP, staged ramp tranches, and POC credit schedule

Subject: Draft MAP + initial POC credit proposal (DL-5492)

Hi Samantha —

Great to chat today. As promised, attached is a draft mutual action plan that lays out a tight 6-week evaluation cadence, key success milestones, and the commercial levers we discussed. High level:

- Week 0–2: Integration & baseline eval (we provide 50k token credit tranche)
- Week 3–4: Performance validation and latency targets; additional 75k token credit if success criteria met
- Week 5–6: Business case review + conversion window; proposed conversion discount if customer commits to a minimum 6-month reserved capacity

We propose the following conversion economics as a starting point:
- 10% conversion discount on hosted API list pricing for a 6-month reserved commitment (minimum $30k/mo run-rate)
- If Nimbus signs within 14 days of completing the MAP, we hold the extension credits for 30 days

Attached: MAP-draft-Nov1.pdf with milestone acceptance criteria and a separate pricing appendix.

Next steps: would love your feedback on the acceptance criteria (particularly the latency SLA) and confirmation that procurement is included so we can route the contract path.

Thanks — I’ll loop Marissa to schedule a live runbook walkthrough next week.

Best,
Priyom

Thanks, Priyom —

2) Timeline: we need a two-week extension on the baseline evaluation window — can you accommodate that? Our onboarding calendar is constrained the week of Nov 15.
3) Procurement: would appreciate an indicative quote that maps the staged credit tranches to line items so our procurement team can preliminarily approve budget.

If we get the security answers and an updated credit schedule, procurement can move to an approval call the week of Nov 22.

Hi Samantha —

Thanks for the quick feedback and the security questions — Ben (cc’d) will handle the technical responses in a separate email, but high-level: we support KMS integration, encrypted logs, and can provide a SOC2 report; Ben will attach the details.

Regarding timing and credits: we can accommodate a 2-week shift to the baseline window. To keep incentives aligned, we propose splitting credits into three tranches and mapping them to deliverables:

- Tranche A (upon integration success): 50k token credit (applied immediately)
- Tranche B (after performance validation & acceptance test): 75k token credit
- Tranche C (conversion buffer to be used within 30 days after MAP sign-off): 25k token credit

Total POC credit pool: 150k tokens. We’ll provide an itemized quote that ties each tranche to line items and acceptance evidence — attached (pricing-tranche-v2.xlsx).

Commercial sweetener proposal: if Nimbus signs a 6-month reserved commit within 30 days of MAP completion, we’ll honor a 10% conversion discount off the quoted unit price and provide a one-time onboarding credit equivalent to one tranche (25k tokens) for the production rollout.

I’ve opened a HubSpot record and the deal id is DL-5492 — adding the procurement contact there so approvals can be tracked. Also linking the shared MAP folder here: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/1A2b3MAP_shared_drive_link

Let me know if that tranche breakdown works and we’ll produce a redline-friendly MAP for signature.

—Priyom

Quick internal —

Ben / Priyom — I spoke with the revenue ops lead and we have flexibility: we can provide the 2-week extension request and keep the 150k token credit pool intact, but I need to confirm the conversion discount is tied to a minimum 6-month reserved commit and that procurement signs the MAP within 30 days of acceptance. If procurement requires longer signature windows, we'll need to move the conversion discount to a tiered structure (8% at 30 days, 5% at 60 days).

Rachel — can you sign off on holding the onboarding tranche (25k tokens) for production if legal is comfortable with a 30-day signature window? I’ll draft the customer-facing language to avoid ambiguity.
